Book Title: Les misérables Author: Hugo, Victor Publisher: Paris: J. Hetzel et A. Lacroix, 1867
Collection of tools and implements used by thieves and burglars including, among other things, a mask, a lantern, a rope ladder, keys and lock-picking instruments, a knife, and a spanner. The caption reads in the original French: "Les mines et les mineurs."
